children: The Bank of England is likely to come under pressure to increase interest rates in future as the U.K. inflation outlook signals above target inflation over the coming months, eToro's Lale Akoner says in a note. U.K. annual headline CPI inflation for August rose to 3.1% from 2.9% in July, but was in line with the consensus forecast by economists in a WSJ poll. "With household energy bills potentially rising by 25% in January and inflation forecast to exceed 4% next year, the risk of higher prices spreading into wages, services and household expectations is growing." Markets price in a total of four BOE rate rises by July, LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
